verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's Data API exposes 'identity' data alongside accounts/transactions/balances, and its Verification API explicitly compares identity data (name) against connected account holders — supporting name-based ownership matching. However, the evidence never confirms retrieval of addresses or contact details on file at the bank, only name matching. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of address/contact fields returned by the identity endpoint, and any hands-on confirmation of full account-holder profile retrieval.
